primary_web.applied: Only explicit nowplaying=true drives the wall. A completed scrobble remains history. Reading needs username/API key but no listener authentication.
Typed access, missing-profile, rate-limit and service-unavailable outcomes; fixed public error copy never reflects upstream URLs or keys.
Now Playing is a distinct optional report from a completed scrobble, so the page avoids promising live artwork from history-only scrobblers.

limitations: Live personal Last.fm credentials and external API responses are not used by automated fixtures.
